cop31.deck: Two weeks of talks in Antalya run past Friday's deadline with no deal, after a draft stripped out every mention of fossil fuels. Delegates work through the night; a third draft is promised for Saturday morning.
cop31.headline: COP31 runs into overtime
cop31.photo_caption: A WIND TURBINE AGAINST THE SKY — FILE PHOTO

lead.deck: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake strikes the Andean region of Junín just after midnight UTC, shaking buildings in Lima 320 km away and sending lawmakers out of Congress. No immediate reports of casualties or major damage.
lead.headline: Quake shakes Peru in the night
lead.photo_caption: THE ANDES NEAR JUNÍN — FILE PHOTO

markets.deck: Foreign investors put a record ₹1.22 lakh crore into Indian shares in November, depository data show — the biggest monthly inflow on record, beating November 2020's ₹70,896 crore.
markets.headline: Record month for foreign money in India

rahul.deck: Resuming on 52, KL Rahul reaches three figures off 207 balls on day three of the first Test in Wellington — the first Indian opener to score Test centuries in South Africa, England, New Zealand and Australia.
rahul.headline: Rahul completes the SENA set
rahul.photo_caption: A BATSMAN PLAYS A SHOT IN WHITES — FILE PHOTO
